scope: Personal directory paths, container hostname, physical GPU UUIDs and PCI bus addresses use consistent pseudonyms. Numeric measurements and recovery events are retained.
gpu_mapping: Stable aliases by physical device index; public UUIDs do not identify the original hardware.
original_execution_checks: Historical results are retained; public identifiers only permit cross-record consistency checks.
checkpoint_sha256: Historical reported digests; checkpoint blobs are not included or rehashed.
historical_checksums: Original export/import SHA records are retained as historical provenance. Current public file integrity is defined by evidence_manifest.json.
